title: Design of a stapled peptide that binds to the Ebola virus matrix protein dimer interface
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,963-974
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00048C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Roopashi Saxena, Madison M. Wright, Benjamin M. Rathman, Ukesh Karki, Prem P. Chapagain, Juan R. Del Valle, Robert V. Stahelin
The structure of the VP40 dimer interface was used to design a series of constrained peptides that mimic the interaction. Constrained peptides were probed for VP40 binding affinity and ability to shift VP40 dimer–monomer equilibrium.
